name: NASN150
tagline: Mini-ITX Alder / Twin Lake-N NAS motherboard with dual 2.5GbE
description: NASN150 is a 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard with Intel N100 / i3-N305 / N150 / i3-N355 options, up to 48GB DDR5, dual Intel i226-V 2.5GbE, two M.2 NVMe PCIe 3.0 x1 slots and six SATA ports via ASM1166. A PCIe 3.0 x4 slot and ATX power connectors support system integration. Reserved eMMC solder pads are not populated by default.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel Alder Lake-N N100 / i3-N305; Intel Twin Lake N150 / i3-N355

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.value: Mini-ITX, 170 x 170 mm (6.7 x 6.7 in); all solid-state capacitors

specs.label: Base power consumption
specs.value: Motherboard base power consumption: 18W-23W (depends on CPU); Whole system base power consumption: 25W-35W; (excluding hard drives, depends on CPU model)

specs.label: System
specs.value: Compatible with Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit and Linux; UEFI mode only

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 1 x USB3.0; 3 x USB2.0; 1 x HDMI 2.0; 1 x DP 1.4; 2 x RJ45 2.5GbE; 1 x audio interface

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 1 x SYSFAN1 (supports PWM); 1 x SYSFAN2 (does not support PWM); 1 x 4Pin ATX CPU power supply connector; 1 x 24Pin ATX motherboard power supply connector; 1 x USB 3.0 header; 2 x M.2 NVMe PCIe 3.0 x 1 2280; 1 x SO-DIMM DDR5 single memory slot; 6 x SATA 3.0 (ASM1166); 1 x Power switch header (_FPANEL pin); 1 x Buzzer; 1 x PCIe x4 slot (PCIe 3.0 x 4 signal); 1 x USB 2.0 socket; 1 x USB 3.0 pin header; 1 x GPIO pin header; 1 x 2pin JBAT pin (Clear CMOS)

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 2 x M.2 NVMe PCIe 3.0 x 1 (2280); 6 x SATA3.0 6Gb/s (expanded via ASM1166 chip); 1 x TF card slot; 1 x eMMC storage (not populated by default, solder pads reserved)
